title: The Rev. Edward Atkinson

Master of Clare College, Cambridge.

Atkinson married [Frances Hester Carter Smith](/person/71), sister of CMY\'s correspondent Ann Carter Smith, on becoming Master of Clare College, Cambridge in 1856 and held that office to his death.
